I've implemented the tabbed plugins popup. Here's a summary of the changes.

## What I did

The tab infrastructure (`SelectionTab`, tab rendering, Left/Right switching, search-clearing on tab change) already existed in `ListSelectionView`/`selection_tabs.rs`. My work was to wire the plugins popup into it and add the tracking field.

**`codex-rs/tui/src/chatwidget.rs`**
- Added the `plugins_active_tab_id: Option<String>` field to `ChatWidget`, initialized to `None` in the real constructor.

**`codex-rs/tui/src/chatwidget/tests/helpers.rs`**
- Initialized `plugins_active_tab_id: None` in the manual test-construction of `ChatWidget` (required so the struct compiles; the interface note explicitly called this out).

**`codex-rs/tui/src/bottom_pane/mod.rs`**
- Re-exported `SelectionTab` from the `bottom_pane` module and dropped the now-unnecessary `#[allow(dead_code)]` on `active_tab_id_for_active_view`.

**`codex-rs/tui/src/chatwidget/plugins.rs`** (the bulk)
- Rewrote `plugins_popup_params` to emit tabs instead of a flat list:
  - **All Plugins** (`id: "all"`) — all plugins, marketplace labels shown, original sort preserved.
  - **Installed** (`id: "installed"`) — only `installed` plugins; subtitle `Installed plugins.` and count line `Showing N installed plugins.`
  - **OpenAI Curated** — the curated marketplace (`name == "openai-curated"`); subtitle `OpenAI Curated marketplace.`; rows omit the marketplace label so `ChatGPT Marketplace ·` never appears.
  - **One tab per additional marketplace**, labeled by display name.
- Marketplace tab IDs use `marketplace:{path}` (via `to_string_lossy`), so duplicate display names stay individually addressable.
- Duplicate display names get `Name (K/N)` disambiguation suffixes (`disambiguate_marketplace_labels`).
- `refresh_plugins_popup_if_open` now calls `sync_plugins_active_tab_id` to capture the live tab ID before rebuilding, and passes it as `initial_tab_id` — so a data refresh keeps the user on the same tab.
- Column width is computed once across all plugins so it stays stable across tabs.

## Verification
